name: CUBE LUT Pack Preflight
summary: Offline release QA for CUBE LUT packs: validate structure, detect duplicate transforms and naming collisions, and export file-level evidence.
customer: Independent English-market creators who sell ZIP packs containing roughly 10 to 100 original CUBE LUT files through Gumroad.
problem: A LUT pack can ship with malformed tables, repeated titles, duplicate transforms, inconsistent grids, filename collisions, or accidental non-LUT files that are tedious to catch by opening files one at a time.
solution: A downloadable offline browser utility that audits one ZIP or direct CUBE selection with deterministic structural and bundle-hygiene rules, hashes files locally, and exports CSV and self-contained HTML evidence.

acceptance_checks.description: Clean standalone 1D and 3D fixtures report the exact path, type, grid, row count, domain, title, byte size, and SHA-256 with zero structural blockers.
Missing or repeated declarations, late keywords, invalid triplets, non-finite or out-of-profile numbers, invalid domains, and short or extra tables report stable check IDs and line evidence.
Exact bytes, equivalent parsed payloads, duplicate titles, mixed grids, case-insensitive paths, and non-CUBE files are grouped correctly without false duplicate grouping.
CSV and self-contained HTML reports contain release metadata, totals, every file, declared properties, SHA-256, check ID, severity, and evidence without changing input bytes.
The packaged utility scans fixtures from file:// with the network disabled, uses bundled assets only, makes no outbound request, and creates no persistent browser storage.
Unsafe paths, invalid UTF-8, damaged archives, unsupported selections, nested archives, and file, archive, count, entry, and expansion limits fail safely with customer-facing messages.
The versioned release ZIP is deterministic, contains only intended buyer assets and dependency notices, enforces restrictive CSP, and includes no source maps or development files.
The product pull request passes manifest validation plus clean-install unit, release, and Chromium offline-browser checks on GitHub Actions.
Deterministic sanitized fixtures generate four 1600x900 buyer-facing evidence images plus exact sample HTML and CSV reports without customer, payment, or confidential data.
